From: Elena Ruiz <elena@cloudharbor.io>

Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier onboarding — PO, DPA, SOC2 link and subprocessor list

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Thanks for the kickoff call this morning. Procurement at CloudHarbor needs the following to complete supplier setup and issue a PO:

- Vendor security/privacy documents: DPA (or template), SOC 2 report link, and the current subprocessor list
- Any vendor onboarding forms or questionnaire answers (I attached the one we filled out for reference)
- Preferred PO terms and the billing contact to send invoices to

Can you send the DPA we should sign (or a DocuSign envelope), a SOC2 report link we can reference for our internal audit, and confirm how to route the PO? We aim to get this processed the week of Jan 4.

Attached: vendor_questionnaire.pdf

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement, CloudHarbor, Inc.
elena@cloudharbor.io
procure@cloudharbor.io
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — PO, DPA, SOC2 link and subprocessor list

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Next steps from our side and what I’m attaching: 

1) DPA: attached (Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf). We prefer DocuSign for countersignature; I will generate an envelope once you confirm the signees.
2) SOC 2: we host the report behind a secure link — see below for access. If you need a PDF copy for audit, we can grant a time-limited download.
3) Subprocessors: please send your current subprocessor CSV (we also include ours in the DPA appendix).
4) PO path: Redwood procurement instructs vendors to provide a vendor invoice + PO number. To request a PO, supply the W-9 and remittance info; we will route to our Finance PO queue. I attached a short PO_Instructions.pdf that covers the net-30 default terms and the routing email.

SOC2 link (read-only): https://redwood.secure-reports/soc2/2026
DocuSign envelope (will follow once you confirm recipients): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf, PO_Instructions.pdf

If that looks good I’ll prepare the DocuSign envelope and loop in Finance for PO issuance.

Thanks — enjoy the rest of the week,

Marissa Cole
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Elena — quick update from Finance / Procurement: 

- We received cloudharbor-subprocessors.csv and the questionnaire. Thanks.
- I’ve created a preliminary PO (PO-015724) for initial onboarding charges. Please submit your invoice referencing PO-015724 to invoices@redwood.com and include your remit address.
- For PO issuance we need (1) completed W-9 (or W-8 if non-US) and (2) remittance details. Once we have those, Finance will convert the preliminary PO to an issued PO and confirm net-30 terms.

I’ve attached the preliminary PO stub for your internal reference. If you need net-60 instead, let me know — that requires a manager approval and slower processing.

Attachment: PO-015724.pdf

Thanks,

- Please sign the DPA via the DocuSign link (we will send the envelope to contracts@cloudharbor.io).
